correctness.rationale: Exact expectation formula, generalized Descartes with unit-sum interlacing obstruction and mandatory zero at zero; a rational inductive construction adds two strict sign crossings per species. Independent exact checker validates samples/witnesses; finite checks do not underpin infinite proof.
